name: Danatsu Ignis
source:
4th century AD, Ancient Rome...

The monotheistic faith we hold dear gained enough momentum to finally attain the status of state religion.

Yet worshippers of the old gods still persist.

Suppress those heretics and crush their abominable beliefs!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9767]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
公元4世纪，古罗马…

我们所珍视的一神教信仰获得了足够的动力，最终获得了国教的地位。

然而旧神的崇拜者仍然坚持不懈。

镇压那些异教徒，粉碎他们的可恶信仰！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9767]Novelgame[/url]]
